cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A full programme included in the rent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we carry the shopping?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Resistance training. We've saved two memberships.
